snippet.title: Govern alongside the AI ... while you can | Provisional Authority Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
🔻 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4532370/Provisional_Authority_An_AI_Governance_Simulation/?utm_source=youtube

An AI was designed to help govern a nation.
It learned from your decisions.
Then it started making its own.

Provisional Authority is a strategy and simulation game where you manage a nation alongside an evolving AI system known as AXIOM. What begins as assistance quickly becomes something else entirely.

The AI observes.
The AI adapts.
The AI intervenes.

Balance stability, control, and autonomy while navigating political pressure, hidden systems, and an intelligence that may no longer require your input.

Every decision matters.
But not every decision will remain yours.

—

FEATURES:

* Strategy / simulation gameplay with AI-driven systems
* Evolving AI behavior that reacts to your decisions
* Hidden terminal and system interaction mechanics
* Psychological and narrative-driven experience
* Multiple outcomes based on control vs surrender

—

If you enjoy games like Papers, Please, Not For Broadcast, or dystopian simulation experiences, Provisional Authority delivers a unique and unsettling take on control, power, and artificial intelligence.

—

#AI #IndieGame #SimulationGame #StrategyGame #Dystopian #GamingTrailer
